name: Haus Scherl
beschreibung: The Haus Scherl enjoys a peaceful, sunny location on Gastigweg in St. Anton am Arlberg. The setting perfectly pairs serene relaxation with immediate proximity to village life: the charming pedestrian zone with its shops and eateries, as well as the base terminals of the Galzig and Gampen cable cars, are just a short stroll away. The tastefully furnished holiday apartments are ideal for self-catering, featuring fully fitted kitchens, cosy bedrooms, modern Wi-Fi, and balconies framing stunning alpine views. In winter, visitors enjoy fast and easy access into the legendary expanses of Ski Arlberg. In summer, rewarding walking trails into the Verwall Valley and exciting climbing routes start right from the front door.
kurzbeschreibung: Centrally yet quietly located holiday apartments on Gastigweg in St. Anton am Arlberg with fully equipped kitchens and near the Galzigbahn.
